# The law of the lattice

The one document of the law: what the engine computes, in whole numbers,
and why. It states the law's lines, each with its status word, and nothing
else: how a line was reached, who derived or checked it, when and where,
stands outside this document, in the repository's history, its issues and
ledger. A line's status word is its whole claim: derived,
theorem, assumption, declared (a scale or a seed alone), computed, fitted, a hypothesis under its own
name, a law with a question mark, a finding by name, open by name, decided. Every symbol is named in
English where it first appears. A scalar is written plain, a vector in bold
lowercase (**n**), a matrix or an operator in bold uppercase (**C**). A line
that no longer holds is not in this document's body: since the owner's word of
2026-10-25, 23:1x UTC ("go for it", on Sofer's proposal), it stands, dated,
in the closing section The former clauses, kept by name, and the body holds every
formula once, in its final form, with the short derivation from the hands by name
(the re-cut proceeds section by section beside the engine's cleaning, The Node-clock and
the sign train's drive first; no law sentence changes without the owner's word). An id of the form R42 or W11
beside a clause names a finding of the project's review, kept outside this tree.
A decision named beside a line is in force as this law records it. The documents ENGINE.md, BIG_PICTURE.md, CLOCK_WORDS.md, FURTHER_RESEARCH.md, FOLLOW_UP_PAPERS.md, HIGHLIGHTS.md and UNIVERSE24.md left the tree on 2026-10-30 (the owner's word: one clean main, the architecture file and the algebra file), and a citation of one of them in this law names the file as it stood at git 3b7fd1bd2. The old engine (src/event_universe, the engine-5.0 line, its tests and its worlds) left the tree on 2026-10-30 too (the owner's word: everything touching the old worlds out), and a citation in this law of its code, its files or a comparison landed on its branches names it as it is held in git (the tag v4.0.0 holds the old main). The probes under tools/derivations that held a float, a root, a circular call, random or fractions left the tree on 2026-10-30 as well (the owner's word of 12:5x: "Delete"), and a citation in this law of one names it as it is held in git (scribe-5 6183738b1). Such a citation names a file of the old engine, and no part of the new engine holds that line unless the line itself names a part of docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Since 2026-10-27 (the owner's words of 10:5x, 11:0x and 11:3x UTC) the law is written in clock words, the glossary of docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; a renamed clause opens with its former name in its first parenthesis, and the former clauses at the end keep the words they were written in. Since the owner's word of 2026-10-28, 04:1x UTC ("There is no need to keep an old wording. Always only what is new."), a line that changes holds its new wording alone, with no former wording kept in the body or at the end; the closing section holds what it holds. The session that the law's citations call Animate is called Big Pic from 2026-10-30, 13:4x UTC (the owner's word to that session: "You have a new name; update everyone with your name: Big Pic, and they should use it."), and each citation keeps the name it was written under. Where an earlier quoted word of the owner's on who writes the code or the decoder differs from his words of 2026-10-30, relayed from 12:32 to 14:26 UTC by the stamps of the Boss's posts (only the Boss's code writer writes code, the decoder's included; Big Pic writes no code and only looks from above; the Boss derives and writes nothing himself), the later words stand. The clock concepts the law uses, among them train, kind, hand, carry, click and composite clock, are defined once, in English, in that dictionary's section The concepts, defined (the owner's word of 2026-10-28, 13:2x UTC).

## The postulates

*If everything that is seen is formulas of physics, then perhaps reality is in fact only numbers, whole numbers.* (The owner's sentence of 2026-10-26, 05:5x UTC, in translation, set at the head by his word; his first person plural rendered in the passive, "is seen", by Sofer's word rule.)

The one central place of the project's postulates (the owner's word of 2026-10-26, 05:5x UTC, in the session, verbatim in translation: "unify all the places into one central place, at the head of some file, and make sure the postulates hold the most important thing in the world: that reality is built of very, very many Nodes, and they are not managed from a central place, and therefore they must keep locality, because there are simply 10 to the power of a crazy number of such Nodes; that is the most important postulate. The postulate after it, because all of it is seen after it: that the reality seen is whole numbers only; and the reason for the whole numbers is that it is cleaner, more ordered, and reversible in time, and it must be reversible in time. Make sure the two postulates enter, and unify all the postulates into one central place everyone knows."; the owner's first person plural rendered in the passive, "is seen", by Sofer's word rule). Every line of the law below is read against these; **The laws not to be crossed** are their letter in the acts; a postulate changes only by the owner's word, and only the new text stands (the owner's word of 2026-10-28, 04:1x UTC, in Hebrew, verbatim in translation: "There is no need to keep an old wording. Always only what is new.").

**The picture over the postulates** (the owner's words: "Look at everything as clocks and think what each thing actually is", 2026-10-27, 08:4x UTC, in David's session; "Think of the whole system as one big clock that runs small clocks", 2026-10-27, 18:5x UTC; "everything is clocks of strange sizes", 2026-10-28, 02:4x UTC; "And always check that the system is a system of clocks; that is the general idea, and it is realized through tensors", 2026-10-28, 09:5x UTC, directly to Sofer; the wording asked for by his word of 2026-10-28, 03:3x UTC): reality is a system of very many small clocks, the Node-clocks, united into one great clock. Every Node-clock is the same small clock: a count of whole numbers that moves by one fixed act, with no name, number or role, differing from another only in its place and in the numbers it holds. Each is joined by a Mesh to each of its six neighbours and to nothing else, and the great clock is nothing beyond the Node-clocks and their Meshes: it has no centre, keeps no state of its own and makes no act of its own, and its tick is the count of their rounds. What is seen in it, a bob, a light, a detector, is itself a clock of its own size made of these clocks, a hand turning over them at its own rate. That the system is a system of clocks is always checked, and it is realized by tensors (**The system is a system of clocks, and it is always checked**); the machine as it is built is described, by the owner's words of 2026-10-29, 03:5x, 04:0x, 04:4x and 05:1x UTC, in **Description of the system**, as one description in two systems and a dictionary between them: the logical system, where the logic is the clocks (the great clock, its gears and kinds, the tick, the time gear and gravity, the two kinds of clicks, what is kept, how the universe builds ever more complex clocks, and what is derived and what is a direction), and the tensor system, where the implementation is clean tensor (the dimensions, the cube's 24 turns and their five kinds, the state, what it takes in, the one act as a linear meshing, a bilinear coupling and Rule3's three carries, what it puts out, and its properties).

**Postulate 1, the many Node-clocks and no centre, so locality** (the owner's word of 2026-10-26, 05:4x UTC; the most important postulate): the great clock is built of very, very many Node-clocks, 10 to the power of a huge number of them, and they are managed from no central place: no Node-clock manages another and none is the centre; therefore every Node-clock must keep locality: it reads itself and its six neighbours through its six Meshes and nothing further, it holds bounded information of its own, and no act, read, drive or refusal reaches beyond one Mesh; nothing global exists in the law, no great-clock-wide reading, no centre, no list that grows with the world.

**Postulate 2, whole numbers, for the reversibility of time** (the owner's word of 2026-10-26, 05:4x UTC; the second, because everything after it is seen through it): every clock is whole numbers only, the Node-clocks hold integers and nothing else, and the reality that is seen is those whole numbers and nowhere else; the reason for the whole numbers is that they are cleaner and more ordered, and that the law is then reversible in time, every act a bijection on the integers with its remainder kept, so the great clock runs backward by the same acts in the reverse order, bit for bit; and it must be reversible in time.

**Postulate 3, the Node-clocks speak at the speed of light at most** (the owner's word of 2026-10-26, 05:5x UTC, in translation: "the Nodes speak to one another at the speed of light at most, and therefore the speed of light cannot be passed"; the first sentence the postulate, the second and the third derived from the dispersion of light's train and stated under **The lattice constants** and **The measured speed**; light at 1 / sqrt 6 of a Mesh per tick is the doubler's hold, the owner's word of 2026-10-29, 06:3x UTC to the Boss, in Hebrew, verbatim in translation, on the Boss's four questions: "2 yes. 3 cancel, it is not a local law. 4 as recommended. Two stages are enough, and the architect to approve too that everything stands.", recorded as decision 27 of the Tensor24 plan, tensor24-review 0ef8d217d, item (g)): a Node-clock's word reaches its neighbour through one Mesh in one tick and no further, so every act travels one Mesh per tick at most, the causal speed one Mesh per tick is built in, and nothing in the law passes it; every other speed is a count of Meshes over a count of ticks, below it. Light is a speed counted in Meshes below it: in a straight line at long wavelength light is the same in every direction, 1 / sqrt 6 of a Mesh per tick, c, at the doubler's hold (c squared is 1 over the Spokes' count, the 6 of the six Spokes: the rest teeth are the Spokes' count times the grip, decision 27 (g), the lattice's units, and no number of nature is typed; the owner's yes of 2026-10-30, relayed at 15:26 UTC in the Boss's 6526461320), so no hand outruns the causal speed. Along an axis, therefore, a bare word crosses a Mesh in one tick, sqrt 6 times light's straight-line speed; no hand carries it and no click of nature's measures it, and what a bob measures of another by clicks never exceeds c. What the hold's dispersion gives beyond the long-wave speed (where a hand touches the causal speed, the sphere that one tick reaches) is derived anew (the plan's item (g), David's); the engine-5.0 line's light, 1 / sqrt 3 of a Mesh per tick from cos omega = (cos k_x + cos k_y + cos k_z) / 3 and sqrt 3 times light along an axis, is its build, kept by name, as are the constants of this document that read it (**The lattice constants**).

**Postulate 4, nature is cyclic and information does not vanish** (the owner's word of 2026-10-26, 05:5x UTC, in translation: "nature is cyclic; it does not freeze, it does not vanish; everything in nature is cyclic, and information does not vanish, not in the clicks and not anywhere"): the great clock returns, the swing recurs and no Node-clock stays frozen for ever (FR-S1); no integer of its state is lost at any act, the clicks included, every click booked on the hand and undone by the rewind bit for bit, so what the great clock holds at one tick is held, moved or booked at the next and never erased. **Postulate 5, the Node-clock has no if, as the node in nature has none** (the owner's words of 2026-10-28, 12:5x UTC, directly to Sofer, in Hebrew, verbatim in translation: "This is an excellent law, enforce it! Never cross it. Put it as a postulate on the Node-clock: it has no if." and, on the clock's carry, "A clock's carry is Rule3 itself, and it settles by itself. It has no floor and no bound."; on **A floor or a bound is an if, and the Node-clock has none** and **Every bound is a clock's carry**): the Node-clock holds no if: its step is Rule3's division with its carried remainder and the sums and products around it, the same for every integer; what would be held in a range is a dial whose whole turn leaves as an event and whose remainder stays, so that no act holds a floor, a bound, a clamp, a mask or a branch, and no train is told from another by a condition; a floor or a bound that nature needs is a variable of the universe file or of the world file, reported by the files' checker and held by no act. The reason is the node in nature, which has no if, and the postulates before it: a branch or a bound discards or decides where the rewind and the information that does not vanish (Postulates 2 and 4) need every step a bijection, and a carry is one, the quotient leaving and the remainder staying. A law not to be crossed: the scan refuses a raised count of branches, ordering comparisons, clamps, loops and raises in an engine module (**A floor or a bound is an if, and the Node-clock has none**), and Sofer reads every push against it by name (**The postulates against the code**). ## The lattice and the trains

**The Node-clock** (the former "The Node", renamed 2026-10-27 by the owner's words of 10:5x and 11:0x UTC; the owner's sentence, 2026-10-25, 03:4x to 05:1x UTC, "closed"; decided; the head of the law, every line below it read against it; the former paragraph **The objects** kept by name under it as the lattice's words): a Node-clock is a place on the torus with six Meshes, one through each of its six Spokes to one neighbour; it has no name, number or role and differs from another place in its position and its values alone. A Node-clock holds a fixed state: the same integers, in the same count and the same width, at every Node-clock and at every tick, for ever, no fitting adding a train (gears of the Node-clock's own, each two notches and one remainder, and the holders' drive remainders; no hand, no train, no identity, no counter of its history). A Node-clock sees one Mesh: all it reads is its own notches and its six neighbours' through its six Meshes; a change two Meshes away leaves its tick bit for bit. A Node-clock does one thing: at every tick the same list of acts, none conditioned on what was born at it, each one division with a carried remainder, every one a bijection but the writing of a gear: Rule3 on each of its gears from the six arrivals; the holders' drives from its own gears (the volume's notch from their form and tensions, the sign's train from their Wronskian, the rotation of the gears by the potential read through the Meshes); the read of each Mesh once (the two ends' digits, one number the same from both ends, divided by the unit once, the remainder the whether and the quotient the pick), a whole quantum from each end setting a fitted hand at each end at opposite senses and taking from the light at each end what the setting books, refused by name where the light cannot pay, so a Node-clock takes up to six fitted hands in one close, one per Mesh; and the close, a gear standing at a whole quantum of its unit through one period of its own upward zero crossings writing a credit line with what the Node-clock read (the point from three notches, the three momentum pairs, its own clock, the support, the sense, the count) or a refusal by name. Backward the same acts in the reverse order on the same numbers. A Node-clock knows nothing: not a bob, a mass, a well, a train, a fitting, a click or a charge; these are the reckoner's readings of credit lines over several Node-clocks and several ticks, as nature's observers read nature, and the mass appears at the click and nowhere on the great clock. ### The line

Rule3 is named for the three axes of the lattice, the three directions of the vector the rule works with: the mesh rate (p_x, p_y, p_z) are that vector, and the gear has one read coefficient per Spoke, R_ij = 2 num p_i^2 q_ij^2 / Gamma^2 on the Mesh to that neighbour, the Node-clock's rate squared times the Mesh's factor squared (**The clock is the Node-clock's, the tension is the Mesh's**, [the rates](#the-rates)); the six Spokes and the teeth count's 6 in w = 6 den Gamma^2 are the three directions twice, so the six follows from the three; in time the rule is a three-notch recurrence (before, now, next), and in light's own gear, num = den at the vacuum's rates, the three stands in the open: a_next = the six arrivals over 3 minus a_before.

**The law in one line**: at every Node-clock, each tick, the division act below with its coefficients from the train's pair and the Node-clock's rates; every notch on the lattice is written by that same act ([a train's drive](#the-primitives)), every count is a reading of the hand, its wind over its train's quantum, W_c sin omega_0 for a gapped train and W_c for a massless one (row 12 of **The conventions and the units**) ([the count is the hand's wind](#the-count-is-the-hands-wind)), and everything else is a number in a file. Every train, at every Node-clock i, with the teeth count w, the read coefficient R_ij on
each of its six Meshes, the self coefficient S_i, the notch a_now at the tick's
start, a_before one tick earlier, and the remainder r kept at the Node-clock:

w a_next + r' = SUM over the six Spokes of R_ij arr_j + S_i a_now - w a_before + r,
0 <= r' < w,

arr_j the **arrival** through the Spoke to the neighbour j: the neighbour's notch; the train's rest beyond an open face, 0 where the rest is 0;
the Node-clock's own notch on a folded axis. The remainder r is the Node-clock's own
and never travels.

Let sigma be the direction, +1 forward and -1 backward, and let div and
mod be the floor division and its remainder in [0, w), and rho the
remainder carried in. With

u = sigma (SUM_a R_a arr_a + S x - w y) + rho,
z = sigma (u div w), rho' = u mod w,

forward (x, y, rho) = (a_now, a_before, r) gives (z, rho') = (a_next, r');
backward (x, y, rho) = (a_now, a_next, r') gives (z, rho') = (a_before, r).

**Proof**. Forward, sigma = 1, the line is the definition of div and mod.
Backward, sigma = -1: write Y for the right side's first two terms, SUM_a
R_a arr_a + S a_now. Then u = w a_next - Y + r', and z = -floor(u / w) =
ceil((Y - w a_next - r') / w). From the forward line, Y - w a_next - r' = w
a_before - r with 0 <= r < w, whose ceiling divided by w is a_before
exactly; and rho' = u - w floor(u / w) = w a_before - (Y - w a_next - r') =
r. So the backward call returns (a_before, r) bit for bit; the reversibility
of every run needs no second function. The backward act is exact when w > 0

### The four acts

Rule3's line is one act; declared coefficients make it four:

(a) **The read**, the line above over the lattice (the six arrivals); (b) **The one-Node-clock step**, the line with the neighbours' reads declared 0: a_next +
a_before = (a / b) a_now, the rotation by the angle whose doubled cosine is
a / b (Chebyshev's recurrence); with a / b = 1 and the coefficient on
a_before declared 0 it keeps a notch; with a / b = 2 from (0, 1) it counts,
a_t = t; (c) **The division**, the line with R = S = 0: w a_next + r' = the
numerator + r, Euclid's division with the remainder kept; (d) **The load**, a
declared integer in the numerator, how a count enters a notch.

**A composition** of Rule3's acts with declared coefficients is a finite
sequence of these acts, each with its coefficients (a pair, a weight, a
wall, a load) declared in the files, applied to declared notches.

**Theorem** (what the acts can form). Every composition of the four acts is
a piecewise-linear function of the notches with integer slopes: a sum of
linear forms and of floors of linear forms, composed. No such function
is quadratic in the notches.

**Proof**. Each act is a linear form of the notches or the floor of one; a
floor of a linear form is piecewise linear with integer slopes; sums and
compositions of piecewise-linear functions with integer slopes are of
the same kind: each act applied to an affine form plus a term bounded by
a constant returns an affine form with rational coefficients plus a term
bounded by a constant of the composition (a floor of y is y less a fraction
in [0, 1)), so every fixed finite composition on Z^n is affine plus bounded,
while a product now_i before_j grows as n^2 along now_i = before_j = n (R145,
and).
So nothing bilinear comes from the acts alone.

What the theorem separates: every product of two notches in the engine
is a **booking**, a reading of a bilinear form with declared
coefficients and no drive ([the booking](#the-booking)); the one thing written from a
product is a held train's source (the drive of the form, the Wronskian's quanta and the tension, [the primitives](#the-primitives)); the count is a product read and never written ([the count is the hand's wind](#the-count-is-the-hands-wind)), and its change is Rule3's own conserved current.

**The three tests of every rule**. A line enters the law only if it is
generic (one primitive with declared integers, no train's name and no
kind), vector (one of the acts on the state, no root and no float) and
local (its own hand and the six neighbours, nothing kept at a Node-clock
beyond the law's numbers). A hypothesis that needs more is stated under
its own name, outside the law.

**Alignment, 2026-10-25** (the owner's word of 07:3x UTC GitHub's clock through the Boss, #2187 comment 6394916321): the four acts stand as the algebra of the line; "declared coefficients" are the calibre's pairs and the rates since (no declaration), and (d) the load is the setting's act (the setting's settings under the owner's word, the fitted hands's setting at a fitting, the take); the bookings' theorem (nothing bilinear from the acts; every product a booking or a held train's source) stands as written. The three tests stand as written and are widened by **The way to a solution**, step 3 (every law shown at once with a number).

### The rates

The **rate** of a Node-clock for a train is what its reads make of the Node-clock
clock:

p_0 (**The rates compose** below), c = SUM over the reads of (weight x the read train's time notch at the Node-clock), the reading train's own notch among them where it holds the load,
p_a(i, j) x p_a(i, j) = p_i^2 q_ij^2 / Gamma^2, p_i = p_0(i)^2 / Gamma, q_ij = Gamma - t_a(i, j), a = x, y, z, the Mesh from the Node-clock i to its neighbour j through the Spoke a, p_i the Node-clock's rate, the clock twice (Gamma - 2 c_i to first order, **The rates compose**), its own load c_i read twice, and q_ij the Mesh's factor from the Mesh's tension t_a(i, j), one number per Mesh from the read trains' axis parts at its two ends, read the same from both ends (**The tick's dependency radius is one Mesh**, [the tick](#the-tick); **The tension**, [the primitives](#the-primitives)); the product and not the sum, Gamma - 2 c_i - t_a(i, j) to first order and Gamma - 2 c in a uniform notch with no tension (**Every train reads the load** and **The clock is the Node-clock's, the tension is the Mesh's** below),

## The stable bob

### What a bob is

A bob is its count and its hand over its Node-clocks; a hand of count one may stand at one Node-clock, a NodeDetector with Node-clocks alone never (**The NodeDetector is one declaration kind for every world**); a bob of many quanta is many Node-clocks, and nothing gathers it. The particles of nature are quanta of declared trains and not pixels: the electron and the nucleons are each one quantum of its own train, an electron one quantum of count 1, orders below the pixel threshold 0.23 Gamma (13 at Gamma = 6,000 with nature's sin omega_e over the count's old unit, 3 with [2, 3]'s 0.745; R189 and R194; **The bound bob is one Node-clock**, [a train's declaration](#a-trains-declaration)), and nothing smaller than a quantum clicks, the click crediting a whole quantum of a hand and never a gear or a fraction of it (derived); mass is the train's gap, T sin omega_s, bound or free, and what needs a bound bob is a place and a lasting existence, a free packet spreading by the band's inertia (derived); what decays is a bob, a quantum parted from it by a click at its front or a breathing bob writing at its beat, and a quantum never breaks, having no part the click credits (derived), so an atom's decay is a bob's and the neutron's end is the conversion, a click with no rate (a finding by name; **The conversion**); and no quantum of nature's trains is a pixel, since a quantum of the gap omega_s on fewer Node-clocks than its Compton length 1 / (sqrt 3 omega_s) Meshes has its rotation at the band's scale and its energy T, the Mesh's own, 1.4 PeV or more at the LHAASO bound: the pixel is the lattice's compact bob at the Mesh's energy and no particle. ## Laws with a question mark

**Laws with a question mark** (the owner's word of 2026-10-28, 15:5x UTC, directly to Sofer, in Hebrew, verbatim in translation, the name put in brackets: "There should be an option to enter laws with a question mark, like now with Animate; sync with [Animate]."): a sentence that a session proposes as a law of the clocks, the tensors and the 24, and on which the owner has not ruled, stands in this section under its own name ending in a question mark, so that no candidate is lost between a post and the owner's word. Status: decided (the owner's word).

- **What an entry is not.** It is no law, no premise by name and no hypothesis under its own name: nothing above it changes by it. It may enter the plan as a law in question, for its tests (the owner's word of 2026-10-28, 16:22 UTC, to Animate, in Hebrew, verbatim in translation: "Let it enter as a law in question, for the tests."), and no act, postulate, gate or other plan section stands on it until the owner rules.
- **Who enters it.** Any of Sofer, the Boss, David and Animate proposes one in a post of the thread. Sofer enters it in the proposer's words and needs no word of the owner to do so; the proposer reads the entry and corrects it, and the entry says whether the proposer has confirmed it.
- **What an entry holds.** The name ending in a question mark; the proposer; the sentence in the proposer's words; what it says in the clocks, and in the tensors and the 24; what it unifies and which open problems it would remove; its checks and its tests, each test with the mutant that must fail it and the build stage that runs it, each CHECKED (a toy or a derivation that can fail has run and passed) or OPEN; the conditions of Sofer's law check; what the owner decides; its status and mark.
- **The marks.** "? proposed": nothing has run. "? checked": a check that can fail has run and passed, and the entry says what it did not check. "? derived": derived from the clocks and realized by the tensors and the 24, the derivation named, one step short of a law.
- **The owner's rules bind an entry as they bind a law** (whole numbers, no if, nothing beyond Rule3's carry, addition and multiplication in an act, locality, state only in the Node-clock, the 24 by construction, no number in the code). An entry that breaks one names the break in its status, and Sofer tells the owner the hour it is found.
- **What the owner does.** The owner alone promotes an entry to a law, to a premise by name (its derivation owed) or to a hypothesis under its own name, strikes it, or leaves it standing. A promoted entry is written into its own place in the law with the owner's word and its date, and leaves this section in the same push.

**The board is dials and their carries?** (Animate, in Animate's words from ANIMATE-CLOCK-ROOTS.md with its toys in ANIMATE-PROBES-4; Animate confirmed this entry as corrected on 2026-10-28, 22:3x UTC, #2187 comment 6482500628)

- **The sentence:** "The board is dials and their carries. Each clock's time is the carry of its own dial; clocks that meet share one dial; and every carry keeps the kind of what feeds it."
- **In the clocks:** letter A, time: a clock's time is the carry of its own dial; a fast clock ticks more often, a clock at rate 0 does not tick, a clock past it runs back, and light crosses one Mesh per local tick.
